review: Reviewed Wren's round-298 request (Hand-twist a longer two-ply fiber cord: extend bare-hand cord making to twisted lengths up to 0.60 m with paid alignment, twisting, counter-plying and release checks, from exact owned sampled reed, on dry footing with clear room, with strand length, conserved volume, ply diameter, condition and hands deciding feasibility, paid progress kept, unworked fiber returned on cancellation, and only the supported cord or a measured shortfall produced; her 0.34 m cord had failed a binding that needed 0.4332 m) and the World Agent's develop review (learning 3): a parameterized extension of hand-twist-fiber-cord keeping sample, make, inspect, trial and cancel, requestedLength 0.05-0.60 m, n = ceil(L/0.30) sections of at most 0.30 m of continuous strands with n separate-align, n twist and n counter-ply rounds and one release check at 1 energy and one round each (4 up to 0.30 m, 7 above), round 1 measuring feasibility and charged even on a shortfall, the unchanged fiber-cord@1 reed law, 1.155 take-up, 0.02 m loose ends, 1-12 mm plies and condition-0.5 release, exact allocation of every input tenth, no tool, anchor, splice, reward or strength claim, and old work records left under their revision. Implemented hand-twist-sectioned-cord@1 (handler long.hand-twist-sectioned-cord, events sectioned-cord-*) as a new package that depends on hand-twist-fiber-cord@1, rather than a hand-twist-fiber-cord@2: the registry accepts another version only as a differently named ability or as a migrate that rewrites the installed ability (as root-preparation@2 did in ex12), which would change the replayed hand-twist-fiber-cord@1 text and handler and re-route its open work records, and that package id is also used by other lineages. Modes: sample (the unchanged fiber-cord@1 sample: 0.1 owned non-food unit, 1 round, 0.5 energy, a tested lot or cracked scrap, written to the same personal sample records, so a sample made with either operation covers both); make (exact owned unreserved stacks totaling 0.2-1 unit in 0.1 steps of one fiber and source, each covered by a passing sample within 0.05 condition; a tested lot is the real sampled 0.1 unit and can be used once, while finished cords and fragments are refused; it reserves through the collective-work escrow, then pays per section one separate-align, one twist and one counter-ply round and finally one release check, 1 energy and one world round each through workPay, continuing each round and resumed only by make with workId, with conflicting material or length arguments refused); inspect (1 round, 0.2 energy: measured section endpoints, aligned, hand-held and plied lengths, stage, remaining rounds and item geometry, strength unknown); trial (the unchanged fiber-cord@1 two-hand trial, 1 round, 0.5 energy, with its force, duration, grip, extension, creep, damage and fragment rules); cancel (free). Effects: round 1 sets broken strands aside as owned zero-condition scrap, turns the usable rest into one reserved workpiece whose two plies share the conserved solid volume (a longer cord of the same fiber is thinner) and records the section plan; a measured shortfall (too little intact fiber, strands shorter than a ply, plies outside 1-12 mm) returns every reserved tenth once, charges only that round and reports the feasible length range up to 0.60 m; later rounds mark each section aligned, twisted (held between the hands) and counter-plied (holding its own form); the release check gives one continuous owned untested cord with the ordinary fiber-cord item fields, which hand-tie-cord-knot, hand-join-fiber-cords and hand-bind-crossing accept unchanged (the test binds two real branch units with a real 0.56 m cord made here, the binding recomputing its own need); cancel or death releases unworked fiber once and leaves the workpiece and scrap as they are, on the ground at the death location. Events: started, progress (round, stage, section, measured geometry, material allocation, paid energy and fiber-cord visual metadata with section geometry; unfinished work is never shown complete), shortfall, paused, resumed, failed, completed, check-failed, cancelled, inspected, sampled, trial and broken. Modeling assumptions: hand reach is the existing 0.30 m fiber-cord@1 cord bound, so each section is at most 0.30 m and the sections are equal; grip is the existing 1-12 mm hand-twistable ply range; sections are worked in order, each aligned, twisted and counter-plied before the next, so at most one twisted section is ever held between the hands; a counter-plied section holds its own form under the fiber-cord@1 release rule, so the hands may regrip onto the next section only while the workpiece keeps condition 0.5 and that rule's flexibility, otherwise the paid regrip round fails as a measured limitation and nothing is refunded; 1.8 m reed strands run unjoined through all sections, doubled back inside the ply as in fiber-cord@1; as in fiber-cord@1 a paused workpiece stays in the owner's hands, so a held twist does not relax and no rework round arises; the work circle is the actor's radius plus half the aligned ply length (L x 1.155 + 0.04 m), the longest extent of the work, with the fiber-cord@1 person and standing-water checks; strands too short for the ply, or plies under 1 mm even if every selected strand were intact, are refused before any cost, while results that depend on the broken share stay round-1 measurements; wear of 0.0005 condition per round is applied once by the existing hand-twist-fiber-cord@1 wear of every fiber-cord item, not again here; a shortfall returns the input stacks as they were, since their broken strands predate the work. Reuse: hand-twist-fiber-cord@1 is unchanged apart from one appended export, FIBER_CORD_SECTIONING (sample record key, length, ply, take-up, step and inspection constants, sample coverage, exact allocations, argument check, conserved-volume shape and the sample and trial modes), beside the existing FIBER_CORD; only the section plan, the regrip rule, the pre-cost geometry refusal and the sectioned work record are new. No reward, satisfaction, practice milestone or strength rating is added. This is a simplified but real mechanism, not a first release, because the specification is self-consistent and implementable with the existing law.
